subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost adopt an unconditional 30-second WebSocket handshake deadline before reconnecting?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct and well-proven, but the timeout intentionally changes availability behavior for slow proxy or server upgrades, making the exact boundary an owner decision.

options.title: Accept 30 seconds
options.body: Land the fixed deadline because it matches existing sibling practice and bounds an otherwise indefinite reconnect stall.

options.title: Choose another budget
options.body: Adjust the private constant and proof to a Mattermost-specific duration while retaining the same owner-local implementation.

options.title: Defer the timeout
options.body: Retain indefinite waits until deployment evidence establishes a safe default, accepting the existing stalled-reconnect failure mode.

recommendation.title: Accept 30 seconds
recommendation.body: Land the fixed deadline because it matches existing sibling practice and bounds an otherwise indefinite reconnect stall.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the reconnect contract whose availability behavior the timeout changes.
